def.zh-tw: 自然科學探究與實作的四個探究學習內容之一，包含表達與溝通、合作與討論、評價與省思三項：用正確的術語、單位、圖表與模型呈現探究的結果，和別人討論，並評價探究的過程、模型與資訊的可信度。
def.en: One of the four inquiry strands of the curriculum course Natural-science inquiry and practice, made up of expressing and communicating, collaborating and discussing, and evaluating and reflecting: presenting inquiry results with correct terms, units, charts and models, discussing them with others, and judging inquiry processes, models and the credibility of information.
